decisions.evidence: Overall, the combination of sulfuric derivative, sulfonic derivative, guanidine, sulfonamide, TPSA 175.83, NH/OH group count 8, and QED 0.2866 supports the conclusion that oral bioavailability is less than 20%.

Since the query is repeatedly shifted toward stronger ionization and poorer permeability relative to both higher- and lower-bioavailability analogs, the combined evidence supports option (A): has oral bioavailability < 20%.
